stage1.impression: A clean, legible spectrum line-up: the eight tinted cabinets glow, the colours read at a glance, and there is generous room above for type. But the speakers hover rather than stand (almost no contact shadow, no tinted light on the floor), a soft horizon line runs behind every cabinet, a grey band and a cool, muddy grey foreground cut across the bottom third, and the black horn is a crushed chrome blob. It reads as a competent CG render, not a bright-field studio photograph.

blocking_9: Each cabinet visibly sits on the seamless: a dense, tight contact shadow under the plinth edge (floor within 20 px of the base at lum 185-220, not 242)
Tinted light through the acrylic lands on the floor in front of each cabinet, so the ground carries each speaker's colour
The seamless is one continuous high-key field: no tonal line behind the products and no grey band or cool grey foreground (bottom 100 px >= 225, neutral)
The black speaker's horn shows its form with shaped highlights instead of a 34% crushed-to-zero mass
Wider, even side margins so the row does not touch the frame edges

defects.what: Contact shadows nearly absent: floor right under the blue base reads 242.6 vs 247 open floor; speakers look like they hover
Horizontal tonal line where the floor meets the sweep curve, visible behind every cabinet (step about 3 levels, 249.9 to 246.9)
Hard-edged grey band across the full width about 60 px in front of the bases, consistent with the bounce card's shadow on the floor
Foreground floor falls from 247 to 194 and turns cool (R191 G194 B197) against a warm white background: muddy grey, two colour temperatures
Black horn reflects the black surroundings: 34% of pixels crushed to 0, reads as a chrome blob with no form
No coloured light cast onto the ground by any cabinet; the floor is neutral under red, yellow and blue alike
Tight side margins (about 80 px left, 108 px right); the row runs nearly edge to edge
